en: Hello {staff}, your timesheet for the week of {week} is missing. Please enter your hours today and send it for approval.
mt: 你好,您的时间表在 {week} 周缺失.请输入您今天的时间,并将其发送给批准.

en: Hello {staff}, {approver} returned your timesheet for the week of {week}. Please correct it and send it again today.
mt: 您的时间表为2周. 请纠正并今天再次发送.

en: Hello {staff}, you are allocated to {project} at {pct} of your week from {start}. {manager} is the project manager.
mt: 你好,你被分配到 {project} 在 {pct} 的你的星期. {start}. {manager} 是项目经理.

en: Hello {staff}, your allocation on {project} is now {pct} of your week ({hours_wk} hours) until {end}. Please check with {manager}.
mt: 你好,您在 {project} 上的分配现在是 {pct} 在您的周 ({hours_wk} 小时) 到 {end}. 请与 {manager} 检查.

en: Hello {staff}, you are allocated {alloc} of your week on {projects_n} projects, above the limit. Please talk to {pm_name} this week.
mt: 你好,你已经分配了 {alloc} 的 {projects_n} 项目,超过了限制. 请与 {pm_name} 谈谈这个星期.

en: PMO lead: person above 100%
mt: PMO 领先者:超过100%的人

en: Hello {pm_name}, {staff} has {free_h} free hours per week. If you need help on your project next month, tell me this week.
mt: 你好,每周有2个空时间.如果你需要下个月的项目,告诉我本周.

en: Hello {staff}, your {type} from {start} to {end} is approved by {approved_by}. {cover} covers your work. Please hand over before you go.
mt: 您的{type}从 {start}到 {end}被 {approved_by} 批准. {cover}涵盖您的工作.请在离开之前交出.

en: Hello {staff}, we cannot approve your leave from {start} to {end}. Please send {approved_by} another date this week.
mt: 你好,我们不能批准你从1到2的假期.请在本周发送另一个日期.

en: Hello {cover}, {staff} is away from {start} to {end}. Can you cover their project work? Please tell {approved_by} today.
mt: 您可以覆盖他们的项目工作吗?请今天告诉我们.

en: Hello {staff}, your {hours} overtime hours in the week of {week} are approved by {approved_by}. Please log them on your timesheet.
mt: 你好,您的加班时间在 {week} 周的 {approved_by} 已经批准了. 请将它们记录在您的时间表上.

en: Hello {staff}, your course {course} is booked for {date} ({hours} hours). Please plan your project work around that day.
mt: 你的课程 {course} 已预订 {date} ({hours}小时).请在当天计划你的项目工作.

en: Hello {staff}, your rating for {skill} is {age_days} days old. Please check that level {level} is still right and tell me.
mt: 你好,您的评级为 {skill} 是 {age_days} 天的. 请检查 {level} 的级别是否仍然正确,然后告诉我.

en: Hello {staff}, your work on {project} ends on {end}. Please hand over your open items and update your timesheet.
mt: 您的工作结束在2日. 请交出您的公开项目并更新您的时间表.

en: Hello {owner}, the {role} request on {project} starts {start}. Shall we book a contractor? Please confirm today.
mt: 你好,在2开始的请求是3的.我们应该预订一个承包商吗?请今天确认.

en: Hello {approver}, {project} needs a {role} ({skill}) from {start}, open {days_open} days. Please approve the hire.
mt: 您好,需要从5天开始. 请批准租.

en: PMO lead: monthly utilisation ready
mt: PMO :每月使用准备

en: Hello, {vendor} worked {hours} hours on {project} in the week of {week}, a cost of {cost}. Please pay when the invoice matches.
mt: 您好,在3周内工作了1个小时,费用为4个小时. 请在发票一致时支付.

en: Hello, we confirm your booking on {project}: {hours_week} hours a week from {start} to {end} at {rate} an hour. Please confirm.
mt: 我们确认您的预订时间:每周从2小时到3小时. 请确认.

en: Hello, your booking on {project} ends on {end}. Can you extend it? Please tell us your first free date and your rate.
mt: 您的预订结束于1日,您可以延长吗?请告诉我们您的第一次免费日期和价格.

en: Hello, your booking on {project} ends on {end}. Please hand over your work and send your last timesheet.
mt: 您的预订结束在1号. 请递交您的工作并发送您的最后时间表.

en: Hello, please send your hours for the week of {week} on {project}. We have {hours} on record. Please confirm them.
mt: 你好,请发送您的时间. 我们有记录. 请确认它们.

en: Team capacity report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 团队能力报告日期为 {set:firm}

en: A person above {set:over_pct} of the available hours needs work moved to somebody else. A person below {set:free_pct} can take new work. The project manager and the PMO lead agree any change in the weekly resource meeting.
mt: 超过 {set:over_pct} 的可用时间的人需要转移工作给别人. {set:free_pct} 下的人可以接受新的工作. 项目经理和 PMO 负责人在每周资源会议上同意任何变化.

en: Utilisation was {col:util.util} against a target of {col:util.target}, a gap of {col:util.gap}. The check shows: {col:util.state}. The billable share of the hours logged was {col:util.share}.
mt: 使用率为 {col:util.util} 与目标为 {col:util.target},差距为 {col:util.gap}. 检查显示: {col:util.state}.

en: We use this statement in the monthly review with the PMO lead. A low utilisation is first a question about the work planned for the person, not about the person.
mt: 我们在每月与PMO领导进行的审查中使用这个陈述.低利用率首先是关于对人计划的工作,而不是关于人的问题.

en: The labour cost of all hours is {col:projects.labour_cost} and contractors cost {col:projects.contractor_cost}. The budget of the project is {col:projects.budget}.
mt: 所有小时的劳动力成本是 {col:projects.labour_cost} 和承包商成本是 {col:projects.contractor_cost}.

en: Approved by {col:leave.approved_by}. Cover: {col:leave.cover}. The cover check shows: {col:leave.clash}.
mt: 封面: 封面检查显示:

en: Please put this leave in the team calendar and tell the project managers whose projects the person works on. Of these days, {col:leave.days_30} fall in the next 30 days.
mt: 请把这个假期写在团队日历中,并告诉项目经理,该人是谁的项目.

en: To {col:bookings.vendor}. Project: {col:bookings.project}. Role: {col:bookings.role}.
mt: 项目: 角色: 角色:

en: The cost per hour is {col:overtime.rate}. With the premium of {set:ot_premium} the cost of the overtime is {col:overtime.cost}.
mt: 每小时的费用是 {col:overtime.rate}.

en: Skills report of {set:firm}, dated {today}.
mt: 技能报告日期为 {set:firm}

en: The person is allocated {col:staff.alloc_now} of the week on {col:staff.projects_n} projects and has {col:staff.free_hours} free hours a week.
mt: 这个人每周分配 {col:staff.alloc_now} 个项目,每周有 {col:staff.free_hours} 个自由小时.

en: Reviewed on {col:load.reviewed}. Person: {col:load.staff}, {col:load.role}.
mt: 评价时间:

en: The person is allocated {col:load.alloc} of the week ({col:load.alloc_h} of {col:load.hours_wk} hours) on {col:load.projects_n} projects, with {col:load.free_h} hours free. In the last four weeks the person logged {col:load.logged_wk} hours a week. The load check shows: {col:load.state}.
mt: 在过去的四周里,该人每周登录了 {col:load.logged_wk} 小时.负载检查显示: {col:load.state}.

en: Action agreed: {col:load.action}. Main project manager: {col:load.pm_name}.
mt: 主项目经理:

en: We share this summary with the managing director when a person is above {set:over_pct} or below {set:free_pct} of the week, so that hiring, contractor and priority decisions rest on the same facts.
mt: 当一个人超过或低于1周时,我们会与董事总经理分享这个总结,以便招聘,承包商和优先事项的决定都基于相同的事实.

en: Send the statements to the PMO lead
mt: 将声明发送给PMO领导

en: Hello, we paid invoice {inv_no} for {amount} on {paid_on}. Please confirm that you received the payment.
mt: 你好,我们在 {paid_on} 上支付了 {amount} 的发票. 请确认您收到了付款.

en: Hello {manager}, the forecast for {project} is {eac}, which is {over_by} above the budget of {bac}. The cost index is {cpi}. Please send me your recovery plan.
mt: 你好,预测为 {project} 是 {eac},这是 {over_by} 超过预算的 {bac}.成本指数是 {cpi}. 请给我你的恢复计划.

en: Hello, cost line {cost_id} of {amount} for {project} ({description}) has waited {age} days for approval. Please approve it or return it with a reason.
mt: 您好, {project} ({description}) 的成本行 {cost_id} 已经等待 {age} 天的批准. 请批准或返回理由.

en: Hello {manager}, change request {change_id} "{title}" on {project} was raised on {raised}. Please send the hours, the vendor cost and the extra days.
mt: 您好,在 {project} 上的 {change_id} "{title}" 变更请求在 {raised} 上提出. 请发送时间,供应商成本和额外的日.

en: Hello {manager}, please confirm accrual {ac_id} for {project}: {vendor}, {amount}, {reason}. The cut-off is {cutoff}.
mt: 你好,请确认 {project} 的积累 {ac_id}: {vendor}, {amount}, {reason}.
